Apply

Applying as a first-year student

Standardized testing

We are test optional: SAT and ACT scores are optional for students applying for fall entry.

Recommended preparation

Calculus and Physics are strongly recommended for applicants to the School of Computer Science.

English proficiency

International applicants whose first language is not English need a TOEFL iBT score of 100, with at least 25 in each section.

Interviews

Interviews are optional and may be offered to some applicants.
